central_answer: The current one-boundary well-posed action requires GHY but no gravitational joint and contains no matter junction generator. It therefore selects no U, gives V_LH=0, and cannot define K_prop or B_sheet. C3 permits optional nonuniversal circulant bilinears, while bending minimally requires the independent bosonic junction-volume coefficient tau_J.

dependency_graph.optional_fermion: alpha_J and C3 commutant coefficients -> conditional U/M_J -> trace data still required
